title: Horace Martin - Jah Jah Children / version

lines.l: It's a time to unite, unite, my brother, unite, my sister, unite, my brother.
Oh, we can shine your light
The sky's gonna fall from Zion
And the moon is gonna turn into blood
In the finger of an eye
For Jaja, not tell a thing or hate no one
Sing where the hate breaks out of your heart
For this is the time to unite
Oh, we can shine your light.
Oh, we can shine your light.
A weekend to shine your light
A weekend to try to unite
